text:
Maya P: Drafting a compact customer-facing runbook: 'Account Heartbeat + Prefill/Batch/Stream Guidance' Can ppl review quick?
Diego N: Looks useful. Can we capture a lightweight heartbeat metric set so AE can spot slow decay?
Maya P: Thinking: heartbeat = {last_stream_ok, prefetch_hits_24h, avg_tokens_per_request, recent_feedback_score}. Keep it small.
Olivia S: Recommend adding `onboard_percentage` and `last_interaction_ts`. Those map nicely to renewal propensity.
Theo A: For handoffs include a short 'what to try before calling support' list for customers. Saves cs time.
Maya P: Good call. I added a 4-step customer troubleshooting snippet: check header, run curl, compare latency, toggle prefetch.
Maya P: Header examples (edge + runtime hints):
```
X-Redwood-Prefill: mode=smart;ttl=600
X-Redwood-Batch: strategy=adaptive;max_wait_ms=60
X-Redwood-Stream: prefill=3;keepalive=1
```
Diego N: For small installs recommend ttl=1200, for chatty/high-token accounts ttl=300. Document tradeoffs.
Olivia S: Add a telemetry event we can emit from the SDK so AE dashboards light up when a customer degrades.
Olivia S: Example event payload:
```
event: cs.account_heartbeat
props: onboard_pct=0.45, last_stream_ok=false, failed_stream_count=3, prefill_used=8, avg_latency_ms=220
```
Theo A: Include an AE checklist for renewal-risk triage: verify heartbeat, run 1:1 streaming demo, confirm model/quantization settings, attach last 3 survey answers, set `renewal_flag` if risk confirmed.
Maya P: Adding escalation rules: when `failed_stream_count >=2` and `net_sentiment < 0.25` within 72h -> flag as "high_touch" and notify AE + CS lead.
Diego N: Fallback recommendations in runbook: when streaming fails repeatedly -> fallback to non-streaming with smaller model, enable aggressive batching, lower max_tokens, and enable prefix cache.
Olivia S: Include a short reproducible curl test for customers/AEs to run:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-Prefill: mode=smart;ttl=600' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"prompt":"Hello","stream":true}'
```
Maya P: Survey templates: 7-day check (closed): "Rate streaming reliability 1-5", "Any blockers? yes/no"; 30-day (freeform): short "What's working / what's broken" prompt. Keep fields simple so AEs can paste.
Theo A: Map survey answers back to heartbeat: net_sentiment, cited_issues, willingness_to_renew. Good for weekly rollups.
Diego N: Add a lightweight retention of last_successful_stream_ts in the account record. Quick triage signal.
Maya P: I added a short 'customer note snippet' for AEs to paste into CRM when escalation happens. Also a canned email template for outreach.
CS Ops Bot: runbook-created by Maya P (link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/cs-heartbeat-prefill-175820)
Maya P: Thanks all I'll update the onboarding repo and tag AE/ops. Planning to ship by COB. :thumbsup:
Olivia S: No blockers from infra.
Theo A: I'll prep two slides for AE enablement tomorrow.
Diego N: Approve from CS Ops side.
